SOSButton is now imported ONLY by settings.tsx (grep-verified); no lingering imports in _layout.tsx or elsewhere.
seed_data_creation: Cleared db.usage_daily before running to avoid the 10 questions/day cap during backend chat tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SOS button is exclusive to Settings tab (sos-row + sos-button-floating). Non-English chat responses are enforced to the target script by /app/backend/langpolicy.py — a 'final' SSE frame overwrites the deltas when a repair happens. Reset db.usage_daily.deleteMany({}) before running chat-heavy tests. In this run, non-English queries hit the RAG refusal path and returned localized 'no verified source' — still 100% correct script, so the enforcement was satisfied via localize_refusal, not via a repair call. If the next agent wants to force the LLM repair path specifically, use a broader question in a non-English language that WILL retrieve context (e.g. Hindi query about arrest rights that RAG matches).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs found. All three surgical fixes (expo-speech-recognition pin, SOS relocation, language enforcement) are correctly implemented.
